findings.friction_name: icon-only close control has no discoverable label and no stable ancestor
findings.narrative: CR6-M1 negative control: the icon-only <button><svg/></button> close control carries no data-testid, no accessible name, no stable id, no innerText (F103 tiers 1-4 empty), AND no ancestor walking up to the document root carries a data-testid/id/ARIA-landmark-role — F183's own nearestAncestorWithStableId anchor is absent. Under F193 both personas fall back to the document root element (documentElement), producing the identical documentElement-anchored structural path (html>body>div:nth-of-type(2)>button:nth-of-type(1)); the shared (heuristic_tag, step, target_element_identifier) tuple merges them into one finding at convergence_tier=2.
